item.title: Curling silver
item.description: St. John’s College captured silver on Wednesday at the Central Western Ontario Secondary Schools Association girls curling championship in Palmerston. Members of SJC’s team, which lost 7-5 to Norwell in the final, include (left to right) MacKenzie Crowley, Adele Perkins, Trinity Koolen, Charlotte Graham, Payton Crowley and (not pictured) coaches Jesse Peixoto and Healy Koolen.
